_how_to_use: Set level to 'degraded' (or 'down') and write a title and message to show the orange banner in both apps within 30 seconds of the deploy. Set level back to 'ok' to clear it. Set min_version.shopper or min_version.business (e.g. 1.0.3) to show a soft new-version banner, which can be hidden, on older app versions; empty means no prompt. Remove an app from 'apps' to hide the banner there.
